name: Fast Pace
summary: Fast Pace is a mobile reflex game built around short daily competitions. Each day one mini-game is selected from a rotating pool of 20, covering reaction speed, memory and split-second judgement, and every player competes on the same game under the same conditions. Runs last between 5 and 25 seconds. A daily leaderboard resets at midnight, and a separate weekly game keeps its own board for the whole week. Players can also join teams that are ranked by team size. Results show the player's rank and percentile. A practice mode lets players train without affecting the rankings. No account is required.
